positions.name: General Motors Company
positions.catalyst: Q2 2026 beat-and-raise (7/21 AM): adj EPS $3.57 vs $3.15 est on ~$47B revenue; raised FY26 adj EPS to $11.50-$13.50 and adj EBIT to $13.5B-$15.5B; cut expected tariff cost to $2.5B-$3.5B (from $3B-$4B) after Supreme Court struck down IEEPA tariffs, with ~$500M tariff credit expected back.
positions.driver: Clean liquid mega-cap beat+raise with a fresh, quantifiable tailwind (tariff relief). Only ~+1.8% pre-market vs a 5.7% options-implied move, so room to run toward the implied move without chasing an extended gap. High liquidity = tight fills and definable stop.
positions.risks: Auto demand softness (Q2 US units -4.2% y/y); tariff credit not yet received; broad-market/geopolitical risk (Middle East, oil); gap could fade if guidance seen as conservative.
